I need to write a JavaScript function that computes a running total of an array of non-negative numbers, capped at a given positive value. Once the running total reaches the cap, all subsequent positions should remain at the cap.

I drafted two implementations. One uses a boolean flag to freeze the total at the cap once exceeded. The simpler version uses `Math.min(total + num, cap)` to cap the running sum directly.
